bounds: One streamed chat request, at most one text fragment and one terminal frame, five response shapes, and zero fallback resend requests. Generated terminal cases run through a real loopback SSE server, ElizaCloudClient, CloudRuntimeProxy, and the caller's existing empty-result fallback shape.
limitations: Models consumer completion/error classification, not remote model execution or billing. HTTP authorization, provider retries, transport faults, concurrent streams, client cancellation, and server-side work cancellation are outside this proxy's selected contract.
Retaining partial text does not make a failed stream successful. Completion assumes that the finite SSE response arrives and closes; weak fairness is explicit.

assumptions: Weak fairness of frames and settle. The finite authorized SSE response arrives and closes; no claim is made for a provider or transport that never responds.
